issues.reason: "ground feathers" is a plural set taking part in the occurrence, which *Coordination & plurals* gives a group witness; (Member (sk_feathers $e) feather) instead says the scattered thing IS one feather — the class-slot use the group rule explicitly forbids ("a group is an individual; it never goes in a class slot") and false of a plural NP.

The half that stands is that under the correct group typing a descriptive modifier must distribute to the members and never ride the group symbol; the half that does not is the charge against the parse as written — with the object typed as a single feather, (Member (sk_feathers $e) ground) is the ordinary licensed two-atom adjective split ("a dented pail"), so the fault is the singular typing already confirmed at index 0.

gaps_confirmed: a peripheral spatial preposition on an EVENT ("scatters ... around the lantern"): the event side glosses Location as in/at/on while the entity side mandates the surface-preposition head for anything outside in/at/inside/within, leaving Location vs (Around <event> ...) unsettled

the subject role for stative "need" with an inanimate subject: it resists the progressive but is neither possession nor psych/perception, so neither carve-out that moves a transitive subject off Agent clearly covers it
new_gaps: a plural object carrying a descriptive modifier INSIDE a rule consequent has no clean licensed form: the group route's per-member distribution would have to nest an (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) inside the consequent's (And ...), a nesting the instruction set illustrates only for seals and for top-level resultatives
defect_summary: The compliant typing is (GroupOf (sk_feathers $e) feather) in place of (Member (sk_feathers $e) feather); the participial modifier then needs the per-member distribution a plural descriptive modifier requires, for which the instruction set licenses no form inside a rule consequent — filed as the new gap above.
notes: The whenever machinery is otherwise right — plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, STV 1.0 0.9, definite referents typed at top level, no QuantifierPhrase — and "ground" correctly keeps its participial surface form.
